# AWS CodeCommit

Persist regional repository records, tags, and CloudFormation resources without hosting git repositories.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `codecommit` |
| Signing name | `codecommit` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2015-04-13` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 9 of 80 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-codecommit) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No Git hosting, Git HTTP Smart Transfer protocol, or SSH transport.
- No branch creation, commit history, pull requests, approval rules, or merge conflicts.
- No code triggers, CloudWatch Events notification triggers, or repository webhooks.
- Code and Triggers properties in CloudFormation fail explicitly, and so does a KmsKeyId change (UpdateRepositoryEncryptionKey is not implemented).

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
